transcript.text: Poor people stay poor because they're
afraid of other poor people judging them
for doing the things it takes to get
rich. As sad as this is,
a lot of the people around you when
you're starting out want you to lose
because it helps them justify the risks
that they were unwilling to take. And so
by you making the risk and having the
chance of being successful, it reminds
them of the things they haven't done.

transcript_only_text:
Poor  people  stay  poor  because  they're 
 afraid  of  other  poor  people  judging  them 
 for  doing  the  things  it  takes  to  get 
 rich.  As  sad  as  this  is, 
 a  lot  of  the  people  around  you  when 
 you're  starting  out  want  you  to  lose 
 because  it  helps  them  justify  the  risks 
 that  they  were  unwilling  to  take.  And  so 
 by  you  making  the  risk  and  having  the 
 chance  of  being  successful,  it  reminds 
 them  of  the  things  they  haven't  done.
